module_summary: AXI DMA: AXI-lite register bank programs src/dst/len; a busy controller issues AXI4 read bursts into a realignment FIFO and drains it via write bursts.

anchors.name: r_busy
anchors.why: Idle/busy transfer state; set on start command, cleared on last write ack or done; gates all engines.

anchors.name: w_start
anchors.why: Decoded start-bit write to control register that launches a DMA transfer.

anchors.name: r_err
anchors.why: Sticky bus-error flag from BRESP/RRESP or address overflow; blocks new bursts and forces done.

anchors.name: r_abort
anchors.why: Abort flag set by ABORT_KEY write while busy; stops new read/write bursts.

anchors.name: r_done
anchors.why: Transfer-complete flag when no bursts outstanding; clears busy, resets FIFO, raises interrupt.

anchors.name: o_int
anchors.why: Interrupt output asserted at transfer completion when interrupts enabled.

anchors.name: r_int
anchors.why: Sticky interrupt-pending bit readable in control register.

anchors.name: r_int_enable
anchors.why: Interrupt-enable bit of control register gating o_int.

anchors.name: zero_len
anchors.why: Indicates programmed length is zero; suppresses start.

anchors.name: r_src_addr
anchors.why: Programmed source address register; seeds read address, advanced as data is read.

anchors.name: r_dst_addr
anchors.why: Programmed destination address register; seeds write address.

anchors.name: r_len
anchors.why: Programmed transfer length in octets; sets read/write beat counts.

anchors.name: r_prot
anchors.why: AXI PROT setting from control register driving ARPROT/AWPROT.

anchors.name: r_qos
anchors.why: AXI QOS setting from control register driving ARQOS/AWQOS.

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite write accept: both AW and W skid outputs valid and B channel free; enables register writes.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RDATA
anchors.why: Register readback mux selecting control/status, src, dst or len by read address.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write response valid after register write accepted.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite read data valid after read address accepted.

anchors.name: w_start_read
anchors.why: Issues next read burst when busy, reads remain and FIFO has space for a burst.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Master read address valid for each source burst.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Read burst address loaded from read_address.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARLEN
anchors.why: Read burst length from readlen_w; also advances read address and space counters.

anchors.name: phantom_read
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse marking an issued read burst; updates read address, counters and FIFO space.

anchors.name: read_address
anchors.why: Next read burst address, incremented by burst length per issued burst.

anchors.name: reads_remaining_w
anchors.why: Words still to request on the read channel; decremented per burst.

anchors.name: read_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: Count of read bursts issued but not completed by RLAST; gates done.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Read data ready whenever read bursts are outstanding.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Source read data shifted and realigned into the intermediate FIFO.

anchors.name: r_write_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO write enable pushing realigned incoming words into middata FIFO.

anchors.name: r_read_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO read enable popping words for the write data path.

anchors.name: fifo_space_available
anchors.why: FIFO space reserved by issued read bursts; gates new read requests.

anchors.name: fifo_data_available
anchors.why: Words in FIFO not yet committed to write bursts; gates write burst start.

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.r_realigned_incoming
anchors.why: Byte-realigned read word combined from partial word and RDATA, written into FIFO.

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.r_outword
anchors.why: Destination-realigned output word built from FIFO data, drives M_AXI_WDATA.

anchors.name: w_write_start
anchors.why: Starts write burst when FIFO holds a full burst and write requests remain.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Master write address valid for each destination burst.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Write burst address loaded from write_address.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWLEN
anchors.why: Write burst length from write_burst_length.

anchors.name: phantom_write
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse marking issued write burst; updates write address and remaining counters.

anchors.name: write_address
anchors.why: Next write burst address, incremented per issued write burst.

anchors.name: writes_remaining_w
anchors.why: Words remaining to write; sets burst length, done and length readback.

anchors.name: write_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: Write bursts awaiting B response; gates done and last ack.

anchors.name: write_count
anchors.why: Beat counter within current write burst; produces WLAST.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid, held through burst until WLAST.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data to destination, realigned output word from FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WLAST
anchors.why: Marks last beat of write burst from write_count.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WSTRB
anchors.why: Write strobes for unaligned first/last beats; zeroed on error/abort.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid; retires bursts, ends busy, reports errors.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Write response ready until done.

anchors.name: last_write_ack
anchors.why: Indicates next B response is the final one; clears busy and raises interrupt.

anchors.name: gated_clk
anchors.why: Optionally gated core clock (OPT_CLKGATE), active while busy or AXI-lite traffic.

groups.name: AXI-lite register interface
groups.description: Skid-buffered AXI-lite write/read channels decoding register writes and muxing readback data.

groups.name: Configuration registers
groups.description: Source, destination, length, prot/qos and interrupt-enable registers programming the transfer.

groups.name: DMA controller
groups.description: Busy state with error, abort and done flags; generates interrupt at completion.

groups.name: Read engine
groups.description: Issues boundary-aligned AXI read bursts while FIFO space allows and tracks outstanding bursts.

groups.name: Realignment FIFO
groups.description: Shifts read data to word alignment, buffers in sfifo, re-shifts for destination alignment.

groups.name: Write engine
groups.description: Issues AXI write bursts when FIFO holds a burst, counts beats for WLAST, retires B responses.

groups.name: Clock gating
groups.description: Optional local clock gate enabled while busy or AXI-lite activity is present.
